description_en: Queries the information of Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instances deployed in a dedicated cluster
description_zh: 查询专属集群中的云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-dedicated-cluster-instance-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-e --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --instance-status 1 --instance-net-type 2 --engine Redis --engine-version 5.0 --cluster-id dhg-5f2v98840ioq0000 --dedicated-host-name ch-t4n664a9mal4c0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDedicatedClusterInstanceList

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473764.html operation to query the most recent zone list
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

The instance must be created by using a dedicated cluster. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141455.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
该实例必须是通过专属集群创建的，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141455.html
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The state of the instance. Valid values:

0: The instance is being created.
1: The instance is running.
3: The instance is being deleted.
5: The configurations of the instance are being changed.
6: The instance is being migrated.
7: The instance is being restored from a backup.
8: A master-replica switchover is in progress.
9: Expired data of the instance is being deleted
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态，取值：
0：创建中。
1：运行中。
3：删除中。
5：变配中。
6：迁移中。
7：备份恢复中。
8：切换中。
9：删除过期数据
parameters.name: instance_status

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:

0: Internet
1: classic network
2: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
parameters.help_zh:
实例连接地址的网络类型，取值：
0：公网。
1：经典网络。
2：专有网络VPC
parameters.name: instance_net_type

parameters.help_en: The database engine of the instance. Set the value to Redis
parameters.help_zh: 数据库类型，取值固定为Redis
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en: The database engine version of the instance. Set the value to 5.0
parameters.help_zh: 数据库版本号，取值固定为5.0
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the dedicated cluster. You can view the dedicated cluster ID on the Dedicated Clusters page in the ApsaraDB for MyBase console.

Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
专属集群ID，可在专属集群控制台的专属集群信息页获取。
如需传入多个，ID间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host in the dedicated cluster. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200944.html operation to query the host ID.

Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
专属集群的主机ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200944.html获取。
如需传入多个，ID间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: dedicated_host_name

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页可展示的最大记录数，取值：30、50、100，默认值为30
parameters.name: page_size

BandWidth.description_en: The default bandwidth of the instance. Unit: Mbit/s
BandWidth.description_zh: 实例的默认带宽，单位为MB/s

CharacterType.description_en:
The architecture of the instance. Valid values:

logic: cluster
normal: standard
CharacterType.description_zh:
架构类型，返回值：
logic：集群架构。
normal：标准架构

ClusterId.description_en: The ID of the dedicated cluster to which the instance belongs

ClusterName.description_en: The name of the dedicated cluster to which the instance belongs

ConnectionDomain.description_en: The private endpoint of the instance

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: 实例的创建时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

CurrentBandWidth.description_en: The current bandwidth of the instance, which is the sum of the default bandwidth and any extra bandwidth that is purchased. Unit: Mbit/s
CurrentBandWidth.description_zh: 实例当前的带宽，单位为MB/s，由默认带宽和增加的带宽组成

CustomId.description_en: An internal parameter used for the maintenance and management of instances
CustomId.description_zh: 内部参数，维护实例使用

Engine.description_en: The database engine. The return value is redis
Engine.description_zh: 数据库类型，返回值固定为redis

EngineVersion.description_en: The database engine version of the instance. The return value is 5.0
EngineVersion.description_zh: 数据库版本，返回值固定为5.0

DedicatedHostName.description_en: The ID of the host in the dedicated cluster

NodeIp.description_en: The IP address of the node

NodeType.description_en:
The node type. Valid values:

db: data node.
proxy: proxy node.
normal: regular node. This value is returned when the instance runs in the standard architecture
NodeType.description_zh:
节点类型，返回值：
db：数据节点。
proxy：代理节点。
normal：普通节点（标准架构的实例会返回该值）

Port.description_en: The port number that is used to connect to the node

Role.description_en:
The role of the node. Valid values:

master: master node
slave: replica node
Role.description_zh:
节点角色，返回值：
master：主节点。
slave：备节点

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID of the node

InstanceStatus.description_en:
The state of the instance. Valid values:

Normal: The instance is normal.
Creating: The instance is being created.
Changing: The configurations of the instance are being changed.
Inactive: The instance is disabled.
Flushing: The instance is being released.
Released: The instance is released.
Transforming: The billing method of the instance is being changed.
Unavailable: The instance is unavailable.
Error: The instance failed to be created.
Migrating: The instance is being migrated.
BackupRecovering: The instance is being restored from a backup.
MinorVersionUpgrading: The minor version of the instance is being updated.
NetworkModifying: The network type of the instance is being changed.
SSLModifying: The SSL configurations of the instance are being changed.
MajorVersionUpgrading: The major version of the instance is being upgraded. The instance remains accessible during the upgrade
InstanceStatus.description_zh:
实例状态，返回值：
Normal：正常。
Creating：创建中。
Changing：修改中。
Inactive：被禁用。
Flushing：清除中。
Released：已释放。
Transforming：转换中。
Unavailable：服务停止。
Error：创建失败。
Migrating：迁移中。
BackupRecovering：备份恢复中。
MinorVersionUpgrading：小版本升级中。
NetworkModifying：网络变更中。
SSLModifying：SSL变更中。
MajorVersionUpgrading：大版本升级中，可正常访问

MaintainEndTime.description_en: The end time of the maintenance window. The time is in the HH:mmZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
MaintainEndTime.description_zh: 可维护时间段的结束时间，格式为HH:mmZ（UTC时间）

MaintainStartTime.description_en: The start time of the maintenance window. The time is in the HH:mmZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
MaintainStartTime.description_zh: 可维护时间段的开始时间，格式为HH:mmZ（UTC时间）

ProxyCount.description_en:
The number of proxy nodes.



If the return value is 0, the proxy mode is disabled for the instance. If the return value is an integer greater than 0, such as 1, the proxy mode is enabled for the instance.

This parameter is returned only when the instance is a [cluster]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html） instance
ProxyCount.description_zh:
代理节点数量。

返回值为0时，表示实例未开启代理模式；返回值为大于0的整数时（例如1），表示实例已开启代理模式。
仅当实例为[集群架构]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html）时，才会返回本参数

ShardCount.description_en:
The number of shards.

This parameter is returned only when the instance is a [cluster]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html） instance
ShardCount.description_zh:
数据分片数量。
仅当实例为[集群架构]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html）时，才会返回本参数

StorageType.description_en: The storage type of the instance. The return value is LOCAL_SSD, which indicates [enhanced SSDs (ESSDs)]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html）
StorageType.description_zh: 存储类型，返回值固定为LOCAL_SSD（[ESSD云盘]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html））

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
